decisions.reason: A low-pile decorative carpet within the core rug range is cheap to hold. Two years of presence still leave its value uncertain, so the option stays open, though its overlap with similar carpets raises the risk of a collection cut.

The hand-knotted wool silk carpet is a premium showpiece that reinforces the craftsmanship positioning and costs little to keep listed, so it is worth holding while demand from projects and private clients reveals itself.

This decorative carpet overlaps with A and the withdrawn E, making it the most likely next candidate for consolidation. Its low holding cost still justifies keeping it another year until sales evidence resolves its value.
The corner bench extends the established upholstery and dining offer for residential and hospitality projects, and its holding cost is low relative to its remaining upside.
The multi-model swivel shell chair line serves both contract and residential markets and represents a larger committed investment, so it is held while demand uncertainty resolves.
